raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary
Serve LoRA adapters on GLM-5.3-Flash's KDA layers. Split out of #37753, rebased onto current sglang-miles; the rest of that PR (the glm53next port, KDA unfused layout under LoRA) is already on sglang-miles.

## Changes
- `lora/utils.py`: `b_proj`, `f_a_proj`, `f_b_proj`, `g_a_proj`, `g_b_proj` are known LoRA targets. `f_a_proj` / `g_a_proj` are replicated; `b_proj` / `f_b_proj` / `g_b_proj` shard their heads on the attention-TP group, like the KDA `qkv_proj` / `o_proj`.
- `models/glm5_next.py`: `Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration.get_hidden_dim` sizes the buffers per layer. KDA and DSA layers differ in `o_proj`, and only KDA layers carry `qkv_proj` and the gates; other modules use `get_default_hidden_dim`.

## Validation
radixark/miles#3098 (native LoRA), GLM-5.3-Flash 4-layer slice, 8×H200, colocated, TP2/EP8 trainer, two TP4 engines, R3, lr 2e-3, 5 rollouts:
- adapter served: `train/train_rollout_logprob_abs_diff` 0.0146 / 0.0175 / 0.0169 / 0.0168 / 0.0176
- same run with the adapter not served (`--lora-train-only`): 0.0144 / 1.07 / 4.90 / 26.35 / 12.18
- 76 adapter tensors per sync with `--check-lora-weight-equal`, no mismatch

Not executed: the full 45-layer model; sglang-kernel 0.4.9 (validated on 0.4.7).

         "up_proj",

         "down_proj",

@@ -66,6 +66,7 @@
     VocabParallelEmbedding,
     get_embedding_tp_kwargs,
 )
+from sglang.srt.lora.utils import get_default_hidden_dim
 from sglang.srt.managers.mm_utils import (
     MultiModalityDataPaddingPatternMultimodalTokens,
     general_mm_embed_routine,
@@ -1336,6 +1337,27 @@ def get_input_embeddings(self) -> nn.Embedding:
             )
         return self.model.embed_tokens
 
+    def get_hidden_dim(self, module_name: str, layer_idx: int) -> Tuple[int, int]:
+        """LoRA input/output dims; KDA and DSA layers size ``o_proj`` differently."""
+        config = self.config
+        num_heads = config.linear_attn_config["num_heads"]
+        head_dim = config.linear_attn_config["head_dim"]
+        projection_size = num_heads * head_dim
+        # the pool sizes every target on every layer, so DSA layers get unused KDA buffers
+        kda_dims_by_module = {
+            "qkv_proj": (config.hidden_size, 3 * projection_size),
+            "b_proj": (config.hidden_size, num_heads),
+            "f_a_proj": (config.hidden_size, head_dim),
+            "g_a_proj": (config.hidden_size, head_dim),
+            "f_b_proj": (head_dim, projection_size),
+            "g_b_proj": (head_dim, projection_size),
+        }
+        if module_name == "o_proj" and config.is_kda_layer(layer_idx):
+            return projection_size, config.hidden_size
+        if module_name in kda_dims_by_module:
+            return kda_dims_by_module[module_name]
+        return get_default_hidden_dim(module_name, config, layer_idx)
+
     @property
     def routed_experts_weights_of_layer(self):
         return self._routed_experts_weights_of_layer.value
